Powering Jammu & Kashmir Since 1995

Jammu and Kashmir State Power Development Corporation Limited (JKSPDCL) is a wholly owned Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) of the Government of Jammu & Kashmir, incorporated in 1995 under the Companies Act.
